page_title: Your Lifespan is a Cosmic Joke
date_caption: Created April 6, 2026 for the 15th week of 2026.

news.title: We may have even less control over how long we live than previously thought - The Washington Post

weekly_forecast: This week, the universe laughs at our feeble attempts to control our lifespans. Expect a viral TikTok trend where Gen Z blames millennials for 'ruining longevity.' Meanwhile, Big Pharma will quietly rebrand all supplements as 'genetic enhancers' and double the prices. The real plot twist? The study’s lead researcher admits they just guessed the numbers while hungover.

signs.name: Aries
lines: You’ll impulsively buy a life-extending elixir from a shady online ad.
Spoiler: It’s just expired energy drinks.

signs.name: Taurus
lines: You refuse to believe genetics play a role in your lifespan.
Your secret? Bacon and stubbornness.

signs.name: Gemini
lines: You’ll debate the study’s validity on Twitter for 12 hours straight.
Then forget why you cared.

signs.name: Cancer
lines: You’ll panic and call your mom to ask about family health history.
She’ll remind you that stress is the real killer.

signs.name: Leo
lines: You’ll declare yourself 'biologically immortal' at a party.
No one will argue because you’re too entertaining.

signs.name: Virgo
lines: You’ve already updated your 10-year plan to include 'avoid death.'
Color-coded, of course.

signs.name: Libra
lines: You’ll spend the week agonizing over whether to blame nature or nurture.
Then decide it’s both and take a nap.

signs.name: Scorpio
lines: You secretly know how you’re going to die.
But you’re not telling anyone because you enjoy the power.

signs.name: Sagittarius
lines: You’ll book a one-way ticket to a 'Blue Zone' to cheat death.
Forget to pack your passport.

signs.name: Capricorn
lines: You’ve calculated your life expectancy down to the minute.
And you’re still behind on retirement savings.

signs.name: Aquarius
lines: You’ll start a cult based on 'uploading consciousness to the cloud.'
The first meeting is just you and your VR headset.

signs.name: Pisces
lines: You’re pretty sure you’re already a ghost.
Or maybe that’s just the edibles talking.

generator.lucky_draw: Powerball-style: five distinct 1–69 (sorted) plus one Powerball 1–26; snarky one-liner via same LLM.

lucky_numbers_comment: Your genes and luck are both rigged against longevity, much like today’s cursed Powerball numbers: 2, 20, 33, 39, 67 and 4.
